I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant
Sep 2026 • Solo
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
